prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1114; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the collision. Care was delivered over twelve visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for a cervical strain of this type, with conservative management including manual therapy, stretching exercises, and modalities for pain control. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and limited cervical rotation that support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and strength testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no duplicate or repeated charges. Patient was progressing toward functional goals at the most recent visit, and a home exercise program has been provided with instructions to follow up as needed.
